text: NEW: 🇺🇸 A bill to write the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into law now heads to the full House after the House Financial Services Committee formally reports it. It bars the government from selling, swapping, auctioning or encumbering its Bitcoin for at least 20 years and requires proof-of-reserve reports. Addresses linked to the U.S. government hold 306.8K BTC, worth over $18.7B, per Arkham. Time is short: this Congress ends January 3, and Polymarket gives a national reserve under 5% odds before 2027. Without the bill, a future president can undo Trump's executive order alone. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2125990010159571011

NEW: 🟠 Bitcoin Core discloses a bug that lets one peer freeze a node for more than 12 seconds per malicious message. CVE-2026-117348 abuses the "orphanage": an attacker repeats one orphan transaction with thousands of missing parents, forcing the same costly check thousands of times. Project Loupe, an AI scanner built at Block's Spiral, found it in July. Versions 29.0 to 31.2 are affected. Fixes ship in 30.5, 31.3 and 32.1, and the 29.x branch gets no patch. If you run a node, update. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2125204945230090465
